strongest_angle: Examine the unprecedented antitrust investigation launched by the U.S. Department of Justice against five major television networks following their joint suspension of White House press pool coverage.

key_facts.fact: The U.S. Department of Justice launched an antitrust investigation involving five major television networks—Fox News, CNN, ABC, CBS, and NBC—following their joint suspension of White House press pool coverage.
The networks paused pooled video coverage after the White House barred CNN, MS NOW, and Politico from access.
Major television networks that rotate coverage of the White House learned of the Department of Justice investigation on Friday.

numbers.label: Number of TV networks investigated by the DOJ
